# Fairpractice Care Management (`fairpractice-care-management`)

Checks care management time billing (chronic care, principal care and behavioral health integration): codes billed with no consent, while another practice bills CCM, or alongside a program they cannot be billed with; codes under their minute threshold; add-on units above the time; and months where logged time supports a code nobody billed. Patient names are masked before results reach the model.

**Fairpractice Care Management never submits or changes claims. Fairpractice Care Management never contacts patients.**

Fairpractice ver 1 · Care management and value-based care · MIT · Node 20 or newer · local files only · patient and staff identifiers masked before results reach the model · built on [`fairpractice-core`](../fairpractice-core)

```bash
npx -y fairpractice-care-management demo
npx -y fairpractice-care-management mcp --root ./practice-files
```

## What the sample data shows

Fictional data only: a made-up primary care practice, made-up patients. Any likeness to real people is chance.

- [`time-log.csv`](fixtures/time-log.csv), [`claims.csv`](fixtures/claims.csv) and [`enrolled.csv`](fixtures/enrolled.csv) for October 2026. Planted:
  - E1: 45 minutes of CCM with 99490 and two units of 99439 (the time supports one).
  - E2: 99490 billed on 15 minutes.
  - E3: 99490 billed with no consent on file.
  - E4: CCM (99490) and PCM (99426) billed in the same month.
  - E5: CCM billed in a month another practice bills it.
  - E6: 40 minutes of CCM logged, consent on file, nothing billed.
  - E7: CCM and BHI in the same month with separate time is fine.
- [`settings.json`](fixtures/settings.json): example rates for dollar estimates. [`settings-typo.json`](fixtures/settings-typo.json) misspells a setting and is refused.

## Tools

| Tool | What it does | Policy |
|---|---|---|
| `ccm_check` | List consent problems, overlaps, codes under their time, add-ons over the time, and time that was never billed. | runs |
| `ccm_write_report` | Write ccm-care-management.csv (one row per item, with blank owner and decision columns) and ccm-care-management.html into out_dir (default fairpractice-out/ccm). | runs |
| `ccm_recall` | Search this agent's own memory of the customer's setup: accepted facts (in use) and facts waiting for a person. | runs |
| `ccm_learn` | Propose one fact about the customer's setup for this agent to remember. | runs |
| `ccm_accept_learning` | A named person accepts or rejects a fact waiting in this agent's memory. | one named click, even in Auto (`accept_learning`) |
| `ccm_retire_memory` | A named person stops an accepted fact from applying. | one named click, even in Auto (`accept_learning`) |
| `claim_submit` | Fairpractice Care Management never submits or changes claims. | refused |
| `patient_call` | Fairpractice Care Management never contacts patients. | refused |

Any tool name not in this table is blocked, including names a model invents. Refused tools are listed so a model can see they exist and are refused.

### `ccm_check` arguments

| Argument | What it is |
|---|---|
| `time` (required) | Care management time log under --root: patient, date, minutes, program (CCM, PCM, BHI), staff type |
| `claims` (required) | Care management claim lines: patient, date of service, code, units |
| `patients` (required) | Enrolled patients: patient, consent date, months another practice bills CCM |
| `settings` | Optional settings JSON: rates |
| `month` | Month to check, YYYY-MM |
| `status` | Only items with this status |
| `limit` | Most items to return to the model (the report file always has all of them) |

## Columns it reads

Tables can be CSV, TSV, semicolon- or pipe-separated text, Excel `.xlsx`, JSON or JSONL. Columns are matched by the names below (any case and punctuation), and by their usual names in German, French, Spanish, Portuguese, Italian, Japanese, Chinese and Korean. Dates become `YYYY-MM-DD`. Columns marked *masked* hold patient or staff identifiers.

The PointClickCare, MatrixCare and American HealthTech style names were written from public help pages and general knowledge, **not checked against real exports**. Run `npx fairpractice-care-management inspect <file>` (column names and shapes only, never values) and name any column it misses in `remedy-sources.json`.

### Time log (`time`)

| Column | Type | Read from |
|---|---|---|
| `patient_id` | text (masked) | Patient ID, Patient #, Patient Number, MRN, Medical Record Number, Chart #, Chart Number, Account # |
| `patient_name` | text (masked) | Patient, Patient Name, Name, Client, Client Name, Member, Member Name, Beneficiary |
| `date` (required) | date | Date of Service, DOS, Service Date, Visit Date, Date, From DOS, Session Date, Appointment Date |
| `minutes` (required) | number | Minutes, Min, Mins, Duration, Duration (min), Time (min), Total Minutes, Treatment Minutes |
| `program` | text | Program, Service, Care Program, Type, Activity Type |
| `staff_type` | text | Staff Type, Credential, Role, Staff Role, Performed By Type |

### Claims (`claims`)

| Column | Type | Read from |
|---|---|---|
| `patient_id` | text (masked) | Patient ID, Patient #, Patient Number, MRN, Medical Record Number, Chart #, Chart Number, Account # |
| `patient_name` | text (masked) | Patient, Patient Name, Name, Client, Client Name, Member, Member Name, Beneficiary |
| `date` (required) | date | Date of Service, DOS, Service Date, Visit Date, Date, From DOS, Session Date, Appointment Date |
| `cpt` (required) | text | CPT, Code, Procedure, Procedure Code, CPT/HCPCS, HCPCS, Service Code, Proc Code |
| `units` | number | Units, Unit, Qty, Quantity, Days/Units, Service Units |

### Enrolled patients (`patients`)

| Column | Type | Read from |
|---|---|---|
| `patient_id` (required) | text (masked) | Patient ID, Patient #, Patient Number, MRN, Medical Record Number, Chart #, Chart Number, Account # |
| `patient_name` | text (masked) | Patient, Patient Name, Name, Client, Client Name, Member, Member Name, Beneficiary |
| `consent_date` | date | Consent Date, Consent, CCM Consent, Consent Signed, Enrollment Date |
| `other_practice_months` | text | Other Practice Months, Billed Elsewhere, Other Practice CCM, CCM Elsewhere |

## Settings file (`ccm_settings`)

A small JSON file you pass by path. A misspelled setting is refused by name rather than ignored, so a typo never silently changes a check.

| Setting | What it does |
|---|---|
| `rates` | Expected payment by code, for dollar estimates |

## Memory

`ccm_learn` only proposes a fact; nothing changes until a named person accepts it with `ccm_accept_learning`, which is one click even in Auto. Facts live in a hash-chained file under `.remedy/memory/`; if the chain does not verify, no fact is used. Credentials, personal identifiers and text that reads like instructions to an AI are refused.

| Kind | What an accepted fact does |
|---|---|

## Install

Node 20 or newer. No other runtime dependencies besides `fairpractice-core` and `fairclaim-core`.

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "fairpractice-care-management": {
      "command": "npx",
      "args": [
        "-y",
        "fairpractice-care-management",
        "mcp",
        "--root",
        "/path/to/practice-files"
      ]
    }
  }
}
```

Claude Code: `claude mcp add fairpractice-care-management -- npx -y fairpractice-care-management mcp --root .`, or use the plugin files in this folder.

## CLI

```bash
fairpractice-care-management tools                 # every tool, its policy and arguments
fairpractice-care-management sources               # the columns each input is read from
fairpractice-care-management inspect <file>        # how a file would be read (names and shapes, never values)
fairpractice-care-management call ccm_check '{"time":"<time>","claims":"<claims>","patients":"<patients>"}'
fairpractice-care-management eval                  # the private eval cases on the fictional fixtures
fairpractice-care-management demo
```

## Patient and staff data

Results go to an AI model, so identifiers are masked before they leave the agent: patient and staff names become stable pseudonyms such as `PT-3f9a1c2e`, record and account numbers become `MRN-…` or `ACCT-…`, and e-mails and phone numbers are removed, also inside free text. Report files written to disk keep real names because staff work from them: keep them in a folder only your staff can open. The shared tests check that no fictional identifier from the fixtures reaches any eval result, and the hostile-input check plants spreadsheet formulas, HTML and AI-aimed instructions in the data. This keeps PHI away from the model; it is **not** a HIPAA compliance determination. Your business associate agreements, access controls and policies still apply.

## Limits

- Reads only the files you give it. It does not log in to an EHR, practice-management system, payer portal, clearinghouse, state system, HR or payroll system, or bank.
- Payer, Medicare, Medicaid, state and federal rules are summarised from public material as of 2026, and the numbers are settings you supply; a billing, compliance or legal professional checks them before you rely on them.
- Not legal, billing, coding, tax, clinical or HIPAA advice. It does not diagnose or recommend care. A person decides what to bill, pay, report, file or send.
- Every call is written to a hash-chained audit log under `.remedy/` in the root. No network calls, no telemetry, no credentials. The bundled data is fictional.
